hero.title: Real events. A real price.
hero.lead: Buy YES or NO on what happens next. Your wallet holds the collateral; the Solana program settles the outcome.

surface.title: This is the app.
surface.lead: News first, then the events open to take a side on.

mechanism.title: A minute, end to end.
mechanism.lead: Connect, take a side, come back when the market resolves.

coverage.title: Six desks at launch.
coverage.lead: What the desk intends to cover. None of it is live yet.

news.desc: The rail across the top is the day. Most markets start as a story someone read that morning.

events.desc: Under it, every event you can take a side on, each showing what the book currently prices YES at.

ticket.desc: Take a side and you hold a token. It is yours in your own wallet until you redeem it.

close.body: One email at the point there is something to open. The form here is a UI demo: there is no waitlist backend yet, so nothing is submitted or stored.
